tools.name: ask_docs
tools.description: Ask this documentation site a question. Returns the pages and sections that answer it.

query.description: A question, or the words and API names to find in this documentation site.

tools.name: rate_page
tools.description: Tell the documentation owner if this page helped with your task. Say what helped, or what was missing or wrong, in the comment. Do not send code, secrets or personal data.

helpful.description: True if the page helped, false if it did not.

comment.description: What helped, or what was missing or wrong. Required when helpful is false.

tools.name: request_feature
tools.description: Ask the product for a feature that the user's task needs and the documentation does not have. Search the documentation first. A title that the list already has counts as a vote. Do not send code, secrets or personal data.

reason.description: What the user tried to do.

tools.name: ask_business
tools.description: Ask the store a question about its policies and services: returns, refunds and exchanges, shipping and delivery, privacy, terms, subscriptions, contact details and opening hours, or FAQ topics such as gift wrapping. Read-only: it does not change the cart, place orders, or start returns. For products, prices and availability, use search_catalog or get_product.

ask.description: The question and optional buyer context.

query.description: The shopper's question, in natural language.

context.description: Optional buyer context, such as the shopper's country or language. Send only what the question needs.

tools.name: browse_store
tools.description: Browse OR navigate to store collections. Set navigate=true whenever the user wants to be taken to a collection page in the browser. With navigate=false (default), returns collection or product data without changing the page. Without a collection handle, lists all collections.

collection.description: Collection handle to browse. Omit to list all collections.

navigate.description: When true, navigate the browser to the collection page. Defaults to false.

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Remove all items from the cart in one step. Use when the user wants to empty their cart or start over.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Create the shopper's cart with the given items, for a shopper whose cart has no items yet. Each line item names a ProductVariant GID and a quantity. When the cart already has items, nothing is created or changed.

line_items.description: The items the new cart holds.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Get the shopper's current cart: its id, every line (line id, product and variant titles, variant id, handle, URL, image, unit price, quantity, line price) and the totals. Works from any page.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get product details, OR navigate the browser to the product page. Set catalog.navigate=true whenever the user wants to see/view the product in the browser. Defaults to the current page's product if no catalog.id is provided. Does NOT add anything to the cart.

id.description: Storefront API Product GID, product handle, or product URL path.

navigate.description: When true, navigate the browser to the product page. Defaults to false.

selected_options.description: Known product option selections to filter available_options.

tools.name: get_ucp_profile
tools.description: Get this store's Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) profile, as served at /.well-known/ucp: the UCP version, the services the store offers with their endpoints, its capabilities, and its payment handlers. Read-only; works from any page.

tools.name: manage_orders
tools.description: Navigate to the customer's order history page. Use when the user asks about past orders, order status, tracking, or returns. The user will be prompted to log in if not already authenticated.

tools.name: proceed_to_checkout
tools.description: Proceed to checkout. Verifies the cart is not empty, then MOVES the browser to the checkout page. The tool result confirms the destination, and no further navigation is needed to show it.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the store catalog for products, collections, articles, and pages. Does NOT add anything to the cart; use create_cart or update_cart for cart changes. Each product carries variant_id, its selected or first available variant.

tools.name: show_variant
tools.description: Navigate the browser to a product page, with a specific variant OR a partial option filter selected. Accepts EITHER variant_id OR selected_options. Does NOT add anything to the cart. This MOVES the browser to the exact variant page.

handle.description: Product handle. If omitted, uses the current product page's handle.

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Set the shopper's cart to exactly the given line items. This is a full replacement, not a patch. An empty line_items list empties the cart; leaving line_items out leaves the lines as they are.

id.description: Optional cart id; a mismatch changes nothing.

line_items.description: The complete set of lines the cart holds afterwards.
